description: A thin implement used to lift a cut leaf of gold from the cushion and lay it onto the edge. A flat brush of fine hair, a slightly greased paper, or a piece of fine net stretched on a small frame all serve: the leaf clings lightly and is released over the work with a breath.
name: gilder's tip

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
